properties.notes: The site is allocated as Policy SP12 for care accommodation and/or housing development in the Local Plan adopted in June 2020. The site is also allocated as part of Area of Change Policy AOC7 in the Local Plan 2036.This site is partially greenfield and partially brownfield (as shown on the site location plan). The land area in hectares (and resulting capacity estimate) given relates to the brownfield part of the site only.
